reused_open_dependency_findings.title: Preserve actionable pre-read refusals instead of relabelling them as temporary Main failure
reused_open_dependency_findings.source_evidence: Both language prerequisites throw refusedPreread for every non-2xx response. The catch retains the owner status only inside upstream, but always emits HTTP 503, web_unavailable and retry=safe when the target was not dispatched. A revoked/invalid bearer refused with 401, forbidden prerequisite or rate-limited prerequisite is consequently presented as a transient target outage. Consumers classify sign-in/denial/budget/retry from the outer HTTP status.
reused_open_dependency_findings.impact: The requested operation is correctly not sent, but the browser is directed to repeat an authorization failure and cannot use its normal sign-in/denial/rate-limit recovery. Retry-After preservation alone does not preserve the refusal contract.
reproduction_or_required_public_api_asse: Through the actual Web /api/main route, issue a signed-in GET and an idempotency-key-bearing write with a unique token that misses the language cache. Make GET /v1/me/session-agent return a real 401; repeat with person-preferences 403 and 429.

Assert that zero target operations are dispatched, writes report receipt=not-sent, and the outward status/code retain an actionable identity/permission/rate-limit result with appropriate recovery and owner Retry-After. A genuine prerequisite 503 must remain a typed 503 with phase and exact task intent.
Include cached-language and uncached-language requests so cache presence does not silently change how the same revoked session is classified.
reused_open_dependency_findings.suggested_action: Separate received prerequisite HTTP refusals from transport failures; preserve their actionable public status and safe owner problem fields while keeping phase and truthful not-sent receipts.
reused_open_dependency_findings.confidence: high for source control flow; runtime not reproduced
unverified_premises: Exact downstream browser recovery depends on the particular operation consumer; the reported transport status erasure is explicit in source.
Production Account credential refusal and rate-limit responses were not exercised.
reused_open_dependency_findings.disposition: open dependency; reused independent source finding, not a newly executed failure or a claimed fix

reused_open_dependency_findings.title: Let stale or invalid Collection continuations reach a restart action
reused_open_dependency_findings.source_evidence: The newly added Collection preflight forwards after/parent to the membership owner. Except for 403/404 it converts every non-ok response to 503 before the page component can render. Main rejects malformed/binding-invalid cursors and returns an expired/moved result for changed selected Collection contents. PublicCollectionPage already supplies a first-page restart to RegionFailure for invalid/moved failures, but this branch prevents it from being reached. addressFailureResponse instead retries the identical path and query.
reused_open_dependency_findings.impact: An ordinary previously valid continuation after a Collection change, or an invalid cursor, gets an outage page whose retry repeats a permanently invalid cursor. Owner budget/rate-limit distinctions are also lost at this branch.
reproduction_or_required_public_api_asse: Create an admitted public Collection with more than 20 disclosed members. Follow its actual emitted cursor, then change a selected membership dependency and revisit the old Web continuation; separately request after=not-a-valid-cursor and a cursor from another Collection/group.

Verify the Main status/problem first, then require Web to offer a localized first-page/restart action that removes the invalid continuation while retaining locale and unrelated task query parameters. Preserve a valid group context when the intended recovery is within that group.

Require that pressing retry/restart reaches useful actual members, not the same perpetual 503; preserve genuine temporary 503 recovery and undisclosed/missing 404 behavior. Include 422/429 classification rather than representing every refusal as an outage.
reused_open_dependency_findings.suggested_action: Classify the Collection owner result at admission and route invalid/expired continuation to a real restart state; retain distinct public refusal semantics instead of the blanket non-ok to 503 conversion.
reused_open_dependency_findings.confidence: high for source control flow; runtime not reproduced
unverified_premises: The exact live owner status/code and changed-membership cursor are required integration assertions; no seeded Collection or runtime cursor was used.
reused_open_dependency_findings.disposition: open dependency; reused independent source finding, not a newly executed failure or a claimed fix

reused_open_dependency_findings.title: Failures in the new Collection render reads can escape as successful documents
reused_open_dependency_findings.source_evidence: Proxy admission reads one summary and the membership owner, then rendering independently reads the summary, members and a member-name summary batch. If the later entry read fails, EntityRoute returns ordinary failure JSX; if members or member-name hydration fails, it returns PublicCollectionPage with a RegionFailure. These paths set no 503 response status. Member-name hydration is not covered by the preflight at all, so it can fail even when every admission read succeeded.
reused_open_dependency_findings.impact: The required nonempty localized recovery view exists, but the source-level route returns it as a normal page instead of a truthful temporary-unavailability response. A successful admission does not prove later owner reads succeed.
reproduction_or_required_public_api_asse: Request a real localized Collection Web URL with after, parent and unrelated task parameters. Allow address resolution, proxy summary and membership reads to succeed; fail only the SSR member-name summary POST with 503. Also fail only the second entry-summary read after successful admission.

Assert the final document has HTTP 503, no-store and a nonempty localized recovery body, with exact task retry context; restore Main and require retry to return actual members without restarting the Web process.
Exercise the actual Worker/Vinext HTTP response. Rendering EntityRoute to static markup or asserting role=alert alone cannot establish the response status.
reused_open_dependency_findings.suggested_action: Ensure the entire initial Collection read can produce a typed response status before streaming, or pass an admitted read result through a truthful owner/status boundary; preserve subsequent authority fences.
reused_open_dependency_findings.confidence: high for missing status handling in source; actual framework HTTP status is unverified
unverified_premises: Default successful document status is inferred from the ordinary Server Component return path. The pinned production Worker/Vinext response was not observed.
Do not address this by reusing stale authority results or removing disclosure revalidation.
reused_open_dependency_findings.disposition: open dependency; reused independent source finding, not a newly executed failure or a claimed fix

reused_open_dependency_findings.title: Do not classify an identity read outage as a missing private Collection
reused_open_dependency_findings.origin: Existing shared reader fallback exposed by the new Collection entry/destination caller; the reader fallback itself was not introduced in these commits.
personas: authorized member of a private Collection
reused_open_dependency_findings.source_evidence: The new entry read calls reader(). Its sessionAgentState lookup returns null on any transport/owner error. reader() then drops both the bearer and actingSubject, and readEntityEntry interprets an unavailable anonymous summary as missing; EntityRoute calls notFound(). A private Collection that just passed proxy admission can therefore become a false 404 when the independent SSR identity read has a transient failure.
reused_open_dependency_findings.impact: Private access remains closed, but an identity-unavailable state is presented as proven missing/undisclosed and loses the requested authorized recovery path. This is distinct from genuine anonymous or denied 404s.
reproduction_or_required_public_api_asse: Use a real signed-in principal and eligible session Agent with lawful access to a private Collection. Let proxy identity, resolver and membership admission succeed, then make only the SSR session-Agent read unavailable.

Assert that the Web destination returns localized identity-pending/unavailable recovery with HTTP 503 and the original URL, rather than falling back to an anonymous read and returning 404. Restore the identity owner and verify the same destination opens the authorized members.

Independently retain anonymous, wrong-Agent, revoked-grant and genuinely missing destinations as non-disclosing 404s. Do not obtain recovery by widening grants or trusting a browser-supplied actingSubject.
reused_open_dependency_findings.suggested_action: Preserve a tri-state reader outcome for authenticated/anonymous/identity-unavailable and make the new destination distinguish unavailable identity from lawful anonymous disclosure.
reused_open_dependency_findings.confidence: high for source control flow; runtime timing not reproduced
unverified_premises: Requires a lawful private Collection fixture and a failure between admission and SSR; no such live fixture was executed.
reused_open_dependency_findings.disposition: open dependency; reused independent source finding, not a newly executed failure or a claimed fix

reused_open_dependency_findings.title: Check request cancellation before starting a new detached token rotation
personas: signed-in reader whose access token expired and request was cancelled
reused_open_dependency_findings.source_evidence: refreshTokens checks for an existing rotation, then immediately invokes tokenRequest inside withoutServerRequest. That removes the caller signal before serverRead. Only afterward does waitForRefresh observe that the caller was already aborted. With a fresh refresh-token key and a future deadline, an already-cancelled request therefore starts a new Account POST. The added regression cancels a waiter after dispatch and correctly preserves an existing shared rotation; it does not cover cancellation before a new rotation starts.
reused_open_dependency_findings.impact: Account work and a token-rotation write can start after the sole initiating reader has left. Preserving an already-dispatched shared rotation is appropriate for token-reuse safety, but does not require starting one for a pre-aborted caller.
reproduction_or_required_public_api_asse: Enter withServerRequest using an already-aborted Request signal and a future deadline, then call refreshTokens with a unique uncached refresh token and a counted Account endpoint. Require zero token POSTs and an unavailable/cancelled caller result.
At the actual Web boundary, abort before proxy reaches a missing-access-token refresh path and require no new Account child request. Include cancellation during preceding admission work.
Retain the existing two-waiter case: once a rotation has been dispatched, cancelling one waiter must release it promptly without replaying/aborting the shared rotation needed by the other waiter.
reused_open_dependency_findings.suggested_action: Check the initiating request signal before creating a new detached rotation. Keep existing in-flight rotation ownership and token-reuse protections intact.
reused_open_dependency_findings.confidence: high for source control flow; runtime not reproduced
unverified_premises: Actual Worker cancellation delivery timing and Account token rotation were not measured.
A serverFetch transport deadline still bounds this detached exchange; this is post-cancellation scheduling, not a claim of unbounded lifetime.
reused_open_dependency_findings.disposition: open dependency; reused independent source finding, not a newly executed failure or a claimed fix
